aaa_enabled.summary: Configure AAA authentication schemes and assign local or central authentication.
aaa_enabled.notes: AAA authentication provides robust access control. Ensure users are configured with appropriate privilege levels.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable the Telnet server, enable the SSH (Stelnet) server, and restrict VTY lines to SSH inbound only.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Stelnet must be explicitly enabled and Telnet disabled to secure administrative sessions.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Set an idle timeout of 10 minutes or less on VTY user interfaces.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: The command format is 'idle-timeout <minutes> [<seconds>]'. Setting it to 0 disables the timeout entirely, which is insecure.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Configure a super password using strong cryptographic hashing (irreversible-cipher).
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: 'irreversible-cipher' hashes the password. Do not use 'simple' (plaintext) or weak 'cipher' formats.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Remove default SNMP community strings public/private and add unique strings.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: VRP uses 'cipher' to obfuscate communities in the config. Always replace 'public' and 'private' communities.

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable the plaintext HTTP server; use HTTPS (http secure-server) if web access is required.
http_server_disabled.notes: Enabling plaintext HTTP exposes credentials and session data.

ssh_version_2.summary: Pin SSH server version to version 2 and disable SSH v1 compatibility.
ssh_version_2.notes: VRP supports compatibility with older SSH versions which must be disabled to ensure secure cryptographic negotiation.

logging_enabled.summary: Enable the info-center syslog daemon and configure a remote log host destination.
logging_enabled.notes: Enabling info-center ensures events are captured and forwarded to centralized SIEM/log systems.

management_acl.summary: Configure an ACL restricting management access, and apply it inbound on VTY lines.
management_acl.notes: VTY inbound ACLs are standard security measures to restrict administrative access to authorized subnets.

login_banner.summary: Configure a warning banner to be presented at logon.
login_banner.notes: Warning headers establish legal boundaries and deter unauthorized connections.

password_min_length.summary: Configure the local-user password policy to enforce a minimum password length.
password_min_length.notes: Strong password lengths prevent brute force attacks on local administrative accounts.

ntp_configured.notes: Log entries are only useful evidence if timestamps are coordinated via NTP.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Remove write community strings from the SNMP agent configuration.
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Avoid permitting read-write community strings over SNMP v1/v2c. Use SNMPv3 instead.
